claims.statement: HAK-017 distinguishes declared completeness within an exact collection scope from provider-wide population completeness, permits declared-complete defined subsets, rejects DeclaredComplete when population extent is Unknown, and forbids FullProviderPopulation from carrying narrowing constraints.

HAK-017 permits DeclaredComplete only with known pagination semantics, a model-compatible non-Unknown exhaustion declaration, and non-empty evidence references; this claim does not establish that those references were resolved or that provider exhaustion was independently verified.

HAK-017 enforces retained raw/unique/duplicate arithmetic conservation, requires named deduplication identity/rule provenance, and binds any provider-reported total to the exact declared scope before reconciliation; it does not prove that the named deduplication rule executed correctly.
HAK-017 binds records to the exact inherited HAK-015 canonicalization profile artifact/raw digest and hak.collection-completeness.v1 digest domain, rejecting tested profile/digest/schema tampering.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile the HAK-017 collection completeness tooling.
Validate the HAK-017 JSON Schema syntax.
Lint the HAK-017 machine-readable qualification plan.
Lint the HAK-017 HAK-010 precommitted obligation-to-step binding policy.
Run the focused HAK-017 declaration, scope, pagination-compatibility, count-provenance, digest, and schema-parity regressions.

required_negative_cases: count equality used as sole proof of declared completeness
first page only represented as declared complete without exhaustion declaration
unknown population extent represented as declared complete
full provider population carries narrowing constraints
defined subset silently promoted to provider population declared complete
unknown pagination represented as declared complete
pagination model accepts incompatible positive exhaustion kind
retained unique count exceeds provider reported total
provider reported total bound to wrong declared scope
unique count lacks named deduplication identity or rule
declared complete provider total exceeds retained unique count
unknown exhaustion claims positive evidence refs
unknown collection record field accepted by schema

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to HAK-017 internally consistent completeness declarations, scope/population distinction, pagination/exhaustion compatibility, arithmetic count reconciliation/provenance fields, canonical profile binding, digest integrity, and tested schema semantics; does not verify provider evidence refs, establish actual collection exhaustion, establish provider truth, prove deduplication execution correctness, prove cross-page snapshot stability, establish semantic truth, upgrade upstream HAK qualification, or grant runtime authority
